load_words_from_txt: load words from text files in a folder into a language-to-word-list dictionary
filter_score: filter_score text against a language word list to compute a vocabulary match score
build_language_wordlist: build a language dictionary from .txt files where each file contains one word per line
test_filter_score: test filter_score with Bavarian text and 'bar_Latn' language code to verify contamination detection
review_norm_config: review TextNormConfig settings used by filter_score for text normalization before scoring
